Climate change and the poor

Here we are in the second decade of the 21st century, and climate change is becoming an ever increasing problem. A problem for all of us, rich or poor. But who will feel the effects of this the most? I believe that it will be those of us who are economically challenged, or the poor. It is not that we do not care about the future of our planet, but we do not have the means to help out.

In many poorer countries, they simply do not have the means to prevent damage from global warming.
